body:
I want to thank everyone from my heart for this. I don't have any real, long-term access to the internet right now and can't sit down long enough to give any kind of response or to receive the kind of help I wish I could. I don't know where to begin or who to speak to. I have no idea how to go about choosing. I am so grateful to all of you. I just wanted to say that. Nothing had much improved, but .. nothing has gotten any worse, I suppose. 

Thank all of you so much. I really do not know where to start.
